title: Baostock 桥(Python 侧车 + Go 客户端,A 股行情第三跳)
description: 仿 aktools 模式:scripts/baostock/{setup.sh,bridge.py,requirements.txt}(bridge.py 计划 Task 3 含完整实现,stdlib http.server,仅绑 127.0.0.1:8181,adjustflag=3 不复权;setup.sh 照抄 scripts/akshare/setup.sh 幂等结构改路径包名;requirements.txt 冻结 baostock 版本)+ internal/collector/baostock Go 客户端(GET+decode,~60 行,参照 akshare client 简化)。launchd plist 归 TASK-006。

functional: Go FetchDaily 请求桥 /daily 并把 [{date,close}] JSON 解析为 []core.OHLCV(Time,Close)

functional.desc: bridge.py:GET /daily?code=&start=&end= 经 query_history_k_data_plus(adjustflag=3)返回 [{date,close}];仅绑 127.0.0.1:8181;close 空字符串行跳过;非 /daily 返回 404

boundary: 桥响应空数组时返回空切片且 err=nil

non_functional.desc: setup.sh 幂等建 venv(仿 scripts/akshare/setup.sh);requirements.txt 版本冻结
